(Japanese: '''VSチャーレム！コンテストバトル！！''' ''VS {{tt|Charem|Medicham}}! Contest Battle!!'') is the 51st episode of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'', and the 325th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on November 13, 2003, and in the United States on November 6, 2004. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== May is competing in her second Pokémon Contest and manages to make it to the next round along with Drew, Grace, and a disguised Jessie. Jessie has attached a device to her Dustox that produces beautiful rainbows when it performs an attack, making the attack even more beautiful. May battles against Jessie, with Beautifly delivering enough of a beating to break the rainbow device and defeat Dustox. Caught cheating, Jessie is disqualified. Team Rocket tries to make trouble, but Pikachu sends them blasting off. In the next battle, Grace takes on Drew and beats his Roselia in a decisive victory with her Medicham. Grace moves on to the finals to battle May. Medicham takes a commanding lead until May tries a combo involving Tackle and Silver Wind, pinning Medicham down. May takes the lead with one minute to go. The two Pokémon meet in a head-on collision, and though both Pokémon go down, May has more points and is declared the winner. Drew congratulates May, and then the kids are off to Lavaridge Town for Ash's next Gym Battle. ==Plot== The [[Fallarbor Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]] has finally begun, and {{an|May}} is more determined than ever to win, with {{Ash}}, [[Max]], and {{an|Brock}} cheering her on in the audience. [[Drew]] and his {{TP|Drew|Roselia}} advance to the [[Contest Battle]]s with a score of 29.6, {{ho|Grace}} and her {{p|Medicham}} make it through with a score of 29.5, and May and {{TP|May|Beautifly}}’s twirling {{m|Silver Wind}} achieve a score of 25.9. Contestant 22, [[Jessie]] floats onto the stage disguised as “Jessica”. She calls out her {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}}, and with a rainbow device hidden behind a bow tie, she has it perform rainbow attacks, earning the best score of the day, a 29.7. Drew, Grace, Jessica and May, who narrowly beat another {{pkmn|Coordinator}} by a tenth of a point, are revealed as the top four and will advance onto the second round. The second round starts with May battling Jessica. Jessica sends out Dustox and tells it to use {{m|Tackle}} and add rainbow, a move that {{MTR}} is operating backstage. May tells Beautifly to dodge it and use {{m|String Shot}}. Dustox uses {{m|Whirlwind}} to send the attack back and hit Beautifly, making May lose points. Dustox uses a {{m|Poison Sting}}, which May knocks back with {{m|Gust}}, making it lose points and damaging the rainbow device. Dustox uses Tackle and May counters it with {{m|Silver Wind}}. Dustox loses even more points and damages the device even further. May congratulates Beautifly while Jessica furiously demands a rainbow {{m|Psybeam}}, which fails when Meowth discovers the remote is broken. Beautifly uses Tackle, which sends Dustox flying back into Jessica, losing all of their points at the 1:58 minute mark. May is declared the winner, though Jessica is set on getting her revenge. As Dustox returns to the air, the rainbow device hits the ground and the whole audience sees that Jessica cheated. [[Raoul Contesta]] stands up and angrily demands for her to leave, at which point Jessica screams and throws a yellow Poké Ball prop which releases yellow dust. When the dust clears, Jessica is revealed to be Jessie, with the rest of {{TRT}} standing right there. They tell the audience that they want their Pokémon, and are about to battle with their own. Ash jumps up and tells {{AP|Pikachu}} to quickly use {{m|Thunderbolt}} to blast Team Rocket off. [[Vivian Meridian]] apologizes for the interruption before the second round continues with Grace versus Drew. Grace sends out Medicham and Drew sends out Roselia. Drew starts off with {{m|Magical Leaf}}, which Grace uses {{m|Meditate}} to dodge. Medicham uses {{m|Ice Punch}}, which Roselia gracefully dodges before it uses {{m|Petal Dance}}, which Medicham stops in midair with {{m|Confusion}} and sends back, causing Roselia to lose points. Drew commands Roselia to use {{m|Solar Beam}}. Grace tells Medicham to use Ice Punch on the ground, which builds a shield around Roselia, causing it to hit itself. Grace wins the battle after knocking it out with a powerful {{m|High Jump Kick}}. The final battle pits May's Beautifly against Grace's Medicham. May starts with Tackle, which Medicham dodges with Meditate. Grace follows up with an Ice Punch, but Beautifly batters Medicham away with a Gust. Just before it falls to the ground, Medicham uses Confusion to levitate, limiting the number of points lost. Beautifly tries a String Shot which Medicham sends back with another Confusion, damaging and tangling up Beautifly. Medicham uses Ice Punch, encasing Beautifly in ice. As Beautifly breaks free, Medicham rushes in for a High Jump Kick. Beautifly dodges and uses Silver Wind, hitting Medicham and causing it to [[crash damage|hurt its knee]], costing Grace major points. Beautifly uses a Tackle and String Shot [[Contest combination|combo]], though Medicham uses Confusion to stop it. Still spinning, Beautifly overcomes this with a Silver Wind and encases Medicham in silky thread. May uses Tackle as Medicham breaks out of the string and dodges. Beautifly uses Silver Wind and traps Medicham's hands, immobilizing it. Then Beautifly uses a Tackle and Silver Wind combo to inflict more damage on Medicham. Medicham tries to turn it around with a High Jump Kick, which May tells Beautifly to counter with Tackle. The two approach each other head-on and collide just as time runs out. May is declared the winner of the Fallarbor Contest, as she was the one with more points. She is astounded by her victory over Grace before hugging Beautifly for its efforts. Raoul hands May the pink Fallarbor [[Ribbon]], which she happily places into her Ribbon case. Drew later approaches the group and declares that things would have been different if he battled May. He throws a rose to May before walking off in a smug manner. May, however, is more confident in her Coordinator ambitions while Ash has his sights set on his [[Lavaridge Gym]] match. ==Major events== [[File:May Fallarbor Ribbon.png|thumb|220px|May holding the Fallarbor Ribbon]] * {{an|May}}, [[Jessie]], and [[Drew]] compete in the [[Fallarbor Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]]. * Jessie and Drew are eliminated in the semifinals. * May wins the Fallarbor Contest and earns her first [[Ribbon]]. {{animeevents|AG}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * {{an|May}} * {{an|Brock}} * [[Max]] * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] * [[Nurse Joy]] * [[Drew]] * [[Vivian Meridian]] * [[Raoul Contesta]] * [[Mr. Sukizo]] * {{ho|Grace}} ===Pokémon=== [[File:PTC AG051.png|thumb|200px|right|Pokémon Trainer's Choice]] [[Pokémon Trainer's Choice]]: {{p|Bagon}} * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Beautifly}} ({{OP|May|Beautifly}}) * {{p|Dustox}} ({{OP|Jessie|Dustox}}) * {{p|Roselia}} ({{OP|Drew|Roselia}}) * {{p|Medicham}} ({{ho|Grace}}'s) ==Trivia== * The title is a reference to a line from {{wp|William Shakespeare}}'s play ''{{wp|Macbeth}}''. * The smoke ball [[Jessie]] throws appears similar to the [[GS Ball]]. * Despite {{m|Meditate}} having existed since [[Generation I]], this marks the [[List of moves by animated series debut|first time]] the [[move]] is used in the {{pkmn|animated series}}. * This is the first episode to feature [[crash damage]]. * Music from ''[[M02|The Power of One]]'' can be heard in this episode. ===Errors=== * At the start of the episode, instead of {{m|High Jump Kick}}, {{ho|Grace}} commands {{p|Medicham}} to use "High Jump". * When [[James]], {{MTR}}, and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} are rubbing Jessie's and {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}}'s backs, Wobbuffet pops up for agreement for their speech. At the same time, the sound that is usually heard when Wobbuffet pops out from his Poké Ball is heard, even though he is outside of his Ball already. ===Dub edits=== * In the English dub, Jessie is disqualified from the {{to|Fallarbor}} {{pkmn|Contest}} by [[Raoul Contesta]], despite being already eliminated due to losing her [[Contest Battle]] against {{an|May}}. In the Japanese version, he simply demands for her to leave the stage since the match is already over. ====[[Pokémon Trainer's Choice]]==== * Question: Trainers, which one of these Pokémon evolves into {{p|Shelgon}}?
